narration: You move when the crowd inhales. No boot touches you; no face turns. Beneath the arch, you find the dry maintenance lip hidden above the runoff and cross without wetting the lute. From there you can watch the flooded dead-end hall without entering it: pale figures wade against the current, following a candle stub that burns under water. A roof stair remains behind you. The hall waits for your decision.

payload.method: perfectly timed runoff crawl beneath the crowd’s sightline
payload.objectiveRef: escape the mob surge through the drainage arch
